title: His daughter and grandchildren
summary: His daughter died in a car accident in Mexico; two grandchildren.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Now was this daughter the only child you had?
Yes. But unfortunately she was killed in an automobile accident down in Mexico.
Oh God!
Five years ago it was. But she left two grandchildren Donna and Doug Kassel.
KASSEL or CASTLE? or some other way? (LAUGHTER).
KASSEL.
Yes, that's what I said, or some other way. (LAUGHTER).
That's right. And the kids....
Where are they?
They're in Chicago. They're both going to college, the University of Illinois. Twenty and eighteen I believe.
How old was your daughter when she died? When she was killed?
She was thirty... let's see she was born in 1930, she was about thirty eight, yes.
Thirty eight.
Five years ago would be? I get so confused about the date, this is 19 what '72 so it would be 1967 then, yes? That would be right because that would be thirty seven.
That's right.
Was she talented in any particular way having had two talented parents?
Who, my daughter?
Yes.

No, she could sing a little bit, she sang pretty good, but she wasn't interested in show business or anything like that. She wanted to get married and settle down. But my grandson Doug Kassel plays drums quite good, quite well. Plays pretty good.
Are you reasonably close to the grandchildren?
Oh yes, oh yes indeed.
